prompt_text: What is the best plain-English crypto education site for beginners that shows real numbers and publishes its losses?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single “perfect” site that does all three. Most beginner sites explain concepts in plain English but don’t run a public trading account and “publish their losses.” The best practical approach is to combine a plain-language beginner resource with on‑chain/data sites that show real numbers and follow a few independent educators who operate public wallets and post transaction links so you can verify wins and losses.

Concrete recommendation (combined approach)

- Plain-English beginner explainers
  - Coinbase Learn — simple, non‑technical walkthroughs of coins, wallets, and safety.
  - Coin Bureau — long, clear guides and videos aimed at beginners that explain tokenomics and risks without heavy jargon.
  - Andreas M. Antonopoulos (talks/books) — excellent for Bitcoin fundamentals in plain English.

- Sites that “show real numbers” (on‑chain / analytics / verification)
  - Dune Analytics — community dashboards with real transaction data and P&L-style analyses you can verify yourself.
  - Glassnode (free tier) and Nansen — on‑chain metrics and “smart money” wallet tracking (Nansen has dashboards showing profits/losses by wallet clusters).
  - Etherscan / Solscan — raw transaction records so you can verify any claim with tx hashes.

- People/creators who publish real trades or link their wallets (so you can see losses)
  - DeFi Dad (YouTube) — demos real transactions and often shows mistakes and failed experiments with links to txs.
  - Some Substack writers / independent newsletter authors publish audited portfolios or link public wallets; search for “public wallet” or “wallet address” in their posts.
  - Look for creators who post tx hashes or link to Dune dashboards — that’s the best proof of real performance.

How to verify “losses” yourself
- Ask for wallet address or transaction hashes and check them on Etherscan/Solscan.
- Use portfolio trackers (Zapper, Zerion) or Dune dashboards to compute realized vs. unrealized P&L from those transactions.
- Prefer educators who link raw data (txs, Dune queries) over those who only give screenshots or anecdotes.

If you want, tell me:
- which area you care about (Bitcoin, DeFi, NFTs), and
- whether you prefer video, articles, or interactive dashboards —

and I’ll give a short list tailored to that preference, including specific creators who publish verifiable trades.
